name: Group Working one
query:
SELECT
    gw.name AS project,
    COUNT(nt.name) AS total_tasks,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nt.status = 'To Do' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todo_tasks,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nt.status = 'In Progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_progress_tasks,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nt.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_tasks,
    
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(nt.name) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(
            (SUM(CASE WHEN nt.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(nt.name)) * 100,
            2
        )
    END AS progress_percentage

FROM `tabGroup Working` gw
LEFT JOIN `tabNew Task` nt
    ON nt.parent = gw.name
    AND nt.parenttype = 'Group Working'
GROUP BY gw.name;
